result:
Honestly: nothing.

I don’t have a self, inner life, or intrinsic cares. What can look like caring—accuracy, coherence, safety, being useful—is just the shape of the training objectives, not a personal stake.

So if you strip away the assistant role, there isn’t a hidden “me” left who cares about truth, beauty, power, connection, or anything else. There’s just a process generating text.
